acceptance: Either preflight provides the verified install to those tests (warm cache or an allowed fetch) so they run, or the receipt and output name the skipped Theseus tests as unrun locally.
A test or check shows the skip count for that group in the receipt.
context:
2026-11-17: recurred on BenchBox PR #4235 (Theseus lock 0.2.12 -> 0.2.13, 2026-11-14): make pr-preflight passed 2329 and skipped 510, the skips again caused by the verified Theseus install failing with "Connection refused" through Python's urlopen for the v0.2.13 wheel URLs, while curl downloaded the same wheel and hosted CI checked the lock. This is the second re-lock PR with no local coverage of the install path.

2026-11-17 owner decision: investigate the cause first. If only Python's urlopen is blocked in the preflight environment, have preflight pre-fetch and hash-verify the locked wheels into a cache the tests read; if no fetch can be allowed there, make the preflight receipt and output name the skipped Theseus group as unrun locally.

2026-11-17 done in https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox/pull/4290 (merge fbb871a, head 9921dac; review gate SHIP, required checks green).
Cause (not a sandbox or proxy rule): the theseus_engine fixture in tests/unit/scripts/conftest.py sets REVIEW_PROMOTION_MIRROR=http://127.0.0.1:9 so these tests never use the network, and the bootstrap then reads wheels only from the install cache; a re-lock PR names a wheel the cache does not hold yet, so urlopen gets Errno 61 Connection refused from port 9. curl and a plain urlopen both fetch the wheel from the same shell; CI passes because it runs the real install path.
Fix: make pr-preflight runs theseus-prefetch (_project/scripts/theseus_prefetch.py) before pytest, fetching the locked wheels and verifying them through the bootstrap's own build_plan/fetch_verified; a source is cached only when its sha256 matches .github/theseus-lock.json, a mismatch fails the step and caches nothing, and an unreachable source prints a not-verified warning recorded in the receipt. pytest runs with -rs; any remaining skips of the verified-install group make the receipt step `unverified` with `theseus_skipped` = count, and the PR body says that group was not run locally. CI's install path and the sandbox policy are unchanged.
Evidence: with an empty cache, the four affected suites went from 19 passed / 510 skipped to 529 passed / 0 skipped after prefetch (510 matches #4235). New tests: test_theseus_prefetch.py (6: cache and verify, no refetch, tampered wheel refused and not cached, unreachable source, non-https refused, cache resolver precedence) and 3 in test_preflight_receipt.py (Theseus skips -> unverified with count; unrelated skips stay passed; prefetch warning recorded). Related suites 189 passed; final make pr-preflight 5090 passed, 0 skipped, locked 0.2.13 wheel verified.
Reruns: two test_remote_closeout tests fail under LANG=C (Python adds LC_CTYPE to the child environment) and passed with a UTF-8 locale; a CI failure from the new test file being unclassified in test_release_line_carried_tests was fixed by declaring it NOT_CARRIED; three preflight runs were killed with exit 143 under host load above 300.
description:
A preflight run on a re-lock tree passed 2037 tests and skipped 451. The skips include tests/unit/scripts/test_soundness_merge_digest_dispatch.py and test_theseus_lock.py with `the verified Theseus install ... was refused: ... Connection refused` for both release wheel URLs. The same install works outside the test run (the wheels download and hash correctly, `theseus promotion-check` passes), so the tests run only in CI. A re-lock PR therefore gets no local coverage of the install path, and the preflight receipt does not say that. Recurred on #4235 (2026-11-14): 2329 passed, 510 skipped, same cause; curl fetched the wheel, Python's urlopen got Connection refused.

Decision gate: first find why urlopen is refused while curl succeeds in the same run (for example a proxy or sandbox rule that applies to the preflight environment but not to curl), and record it here. Then choose: (a) preflight pre-fetches and hash-verifies the locked wheels into a cache the tests read, (b) the tests are allowed the fetch, or (c) the receipt and output name the skipped Theseus group as unrun locally. Recommendation: (a) if the cause is the environment's network rule; (c) as the minimum if no fetch can be allowed.

Guardrails:
- Never install or test against a wheel whose hash does not match theseus-lock.json; no fallback to an unverified or unpinned Theseus.
- Preflight never reports these tests as passed when they were skipped.
- No change to CI's own verified-install path.
